snippets.title: Run the Verifiable Intent examples
snippets.code:
# Install (using uv)
uv venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e ".[dev]"

# Run an example
python examples/autonomous_flow.py
python examples/immediate_flow.py
snippets.note: From the README quick start. The package is not on PyPI; install from a clone.

snippets.title: Create an Immediate-mode L2 mandate
snippets.code:
mandate = UserMandate(
    nonce=str(uuid.uuid4()),
    aud="https://agent.verifiable-intent.example",
    iat=now,
    iss="https://wallet.example.com",
    exp=now + 900,
    mode=MandateMode.IMMEDIATE,
    sd_hash=hash_bytes(l1.serialize().encode("ascii")),
    checkout_mandate=CheckoutMandate(
        vct="mandate.checkout.1",
        checkout_jwt=checkout_jwt,
        checkout_hash=c_hash,
    ),
    payment_mandate=PaymentMandate(
        vct="mandate.payment.1",
        payment_instrument=PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT,
        payee=MERCHANTS[0],
        currency="USD",
        amount=27999,
        transaction_id=c_hash,
    ),
)
result = create_layer2_immediate(mandate, user.private_key)
snippets.note: Excerpt from examples/immediate_flow.py (prompt_summary and comments removed). The examples use fixed test keys.
